name: Malone University
tuition_note: Private university single rate. 2026-27 tuition $38,200/yr block + comprehensive fee $1,340/yr = $39,540 tuition & fees, from malone.edu/about/offices/business-office/undergraduate-tuition-and-fees/. Housing is room only: standard room $3,050/semester x 2 = $6,100/yr (board/meal plans listed separately, e.g. 28-meal plan $6,800/yr).
